  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor

Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, October 17, 2024, at 10:00 a.m.
1. ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on September 19, 2024, at 10:03 a.m.
  •  Present: Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Zadorian, Atajan, Kazorian, Chairperson Vidor
  The Agenda for the October 17, 2024, Regular Meeting was posted on October 14, 2024, on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

 2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the September 19, 2024 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting And

  b. Minutes of the October 10, 2024 Special Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Chairperson Vidor

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Atajan, Kazorian

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
a. 2024-2025 Student Ex-Officio Commissioner – Milena Ataian
b. 2024-2025 Student Ex-Officio Commissioner – Sofia Kazorian

  •  Student Commissioners Atajan and Kazorian introduced themselves to the Commission. The
  Commission welcomed the student commissioners.

c. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator
  •  Ms. Loreto Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

4. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS – None

5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.

  •  Arman Keyvanian, Music Director gave a brief presentation regarding the Armenian Pops
  Orchestra and their upcoming concert on November 10 at the Alex Theatre and invited the
  Commission and viewers to attend.
  1
   •  Armen Karaoghlanian: The founder and CEO of the Armenian Film Society gave a brief
  presentation of his organization and a recap of the festival. He thanked the Commission for
  sponsoring event.

6. ACTION ITEMS

a. City-Wide Public Art Landmarks: 134 Freeway / Patterson Ave. Tunnel Artwork
  1. Motion recommending that the City Council authorize the City Manager, or a designee,
  to enter into an Agreement for Commission of Artwork with an artist/artist team to design
  a public art piece for the 134 Freeway / Patterson Ave. Tunnel Artwork in an amount not
  to exceed $300,000 dispersed from the Urban Art Program Fund.

  •  Catherine Forsyth of LeBasse Projects gave a brief update on the tunnel and shared the five
  finalists including an alternate artist that will be in consideration to move forward with the project.
  The five finalists were given ten minutes to present. The Commission asked questions and gave
  their input.

That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby recommends that the City Council authorize the City Manager,
or a designee, to enter into an Agreement for Commission of Artwork with an artist or artist team to design,
fabricate, and install a public art piece for the 134 Freeway/ Patterson Ave. Tunnel Artwork in an amount not to
exceed $300,000 dispersed from the Urban Art Program Fund, as more fully outlined in the October 17, 2024
Report by the Library, Arts & Culture's Principal Arts & Culture Administrator:

1st option: Artist Team Studio Lachlan Turczan & Studio Monroe Isenberg
2nd option: Artists Akiko Yamashita and Caroline Marks specifically the Sunbeam and Tsuzuku pieces

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Vice Chair Yank

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Atajan, Kazorian

7. DISCUSSION ITEMS
a. 2024-2025 Work Plan Progress

Ms. Fukutomi- Jones gave the following updates of programs from the Work Plan that have had recent activity.

a. CITY WIDE ARTS
  Mural Ordinance – Update
  • Staff is in the process of finalizing the Mural Ordinance and will present the draft
  ordinance to the Commission for review and feedback. Staff will plan to host a mural
  ordinance community input meeting in Spring 2025 with the goal of adopting the mural
  ordinance from City Council in Summer 2025.

b. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS – Update.
  Beyond the Box: Utility Box Mural Art Program – Update
  • On October 18 – 20, 2024, 12 artists painted new murals as part of the Beyond the Box:
  Utility Box Mural Art Program.

  2
 c. PERFORMING ARTS
  Jewel City Concert Series – Update
  • On September 28, 2024, the Jewel City Concert Series kicked off at the Artsakh Paseo.
  Only two more concerts remain: Saturday, October 19th at 5:00pm featuring J. Guero
  (Latin Electronic Music) and Saturday, October 26th at 5:00pm featuring Ominous Duck
  (Punk/Alternative Rock Music).
d.  ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS
  Getty PST ART: “Blended Worlds” Exhibit – Update
  • Opening reception was on September 21, 2024, the Getty PST ART: “Blended Worlds:
  Experiments In Interplanetary Imagination” exhibit opened at the Brand Library & Art
  Center. Ms. Fukutomi- Jones showed a glimpse of the event in a short video. She
  thanked Chair Vidor and Vice-Chair Yank for attending. Chair Vidor and Vice-Chair Yank
  shared their feedback on the event.
  Getty PST ART: “Blended Worlds: Hosted by Reggie Watts” – Update
  • On October 5, 2024, the Getty PST ART “Blended Worlds: Hosted by Reggie Watts” event
  at the Alex Theatre was performed to a sold out crowd and featured a performance by the
  Crescenta Valley High School Drumline with special guest, Steven Perkins, drummer from
  the band, Jane’s Addiction. Chair Vidor thank Ms. Fukutomi-Jones for all her work on the
  event. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones thanked the Alex Theatre
  Getty PST ART: “Blended Worlds” PBS Artbound – Update
  • On October 11, 2024, PBS SoCal launched the “Blended Worlds: The Fusion of Art and
  Science at JPL” as part of their arts and culture documentary series, Artbound.

e. MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS – Update.
  i.  The ACE Agency – Update
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones thanked the ACE agency for their work on promoting and
  documenting the Arts and Culture programming via social media and other platforms.

8. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  • Commissioner Zadorian thanked Staff for all their work on all the events, projects and programs
  for the Arts and Culture Commission.
  • The Commission welcomed and thanked the two new student commissioners for being a part of
  the Commission.
  • Chair Vidor thanked staff for their hard work and for working on the Blended Worlds Exhibit and
  Adams Square Mini Gas Station Art Installations.

9. ADJOURNMENT @12:22 p.m.

Moved: Commissioner Zadorian

The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday, November 21, 2024, at
10:00 AM in City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway, 2 Floor, Glendale, CA 91206
